issue.title: Maestro E2E + safe fixtures for chapter ownership, taken warning, and online claim
issue.body:
## Summary

Current ownership/taken-warning behavior has strong unit coverage and passed the exercised live-device paths in the #532 audit, but Maestro lacks end-to-end assertions for these states and destructive claim scenarios cannot be safely tested against shared dev data.

The #532 audit proved the live UI for existing seeded states (mine / other / unassigned ownership, Draft + Peer Check taken warning, Advanced/Complete clearing). Important claim/conflict/open-Peer-Check paths cannot be safely or deterministically exercised because the project lacks resettable E2E fixture state.

## Why

Without deterministic/resettable fixtures:

- online auto-claim cannot be safely exercised
- claim UI updates cannot be proven E2E
- conflict banner/list behavior cannot be deterministically reproduced
- open Peer Check / no-peerChecker state cannot be reliably reproduced
- future audits remain partially BLOCKED/SKIPPED

## Evidence from #532

- mine / other / unassigned ownership UI **passed**
- Draft taken-warning **passed**
- Peer Check taken-warning **passed**
- recording remained enabled on taken chapters **passed**
- Advanced / Complete ownership clearing **passed**
- online auto-claim was **not executed** because it would mutate shared state (SKIPPED — policy)
- conflict UI lacked a safe deterministic seed (**BLOCKED**)
- open Peer Check lacked a deterministic seed (**BLOCKED**)
- existing Maestro flows do not assert ownership/claim behavior

These are coverage/fixture gaps, not confirmed product failures on the exercised paths.

## Expected

Maestro (backed by disposable/resettable fixtures) can deterministically prove:

- ownership a11y states (mine / other / unassigned)
- `record-taken-warning` on taken chapters
- online first-recording auto-claim and immediate ownership UI update
- conflict list + Record conflict banner when seeded
- open Peer Check / no-peerChecker when seeded

without mutating shared developer/QA project data.

## Actual

- Smokes only treat assignment as a seed prerequisite (`≥1` My Work row)
- No Maestro asserts ownership icons, `record-taken-warning`, or claim
- Online claim / conflict / open Peer Check cannot be safely or deterministically run on shared `dev.api.fluent.bible` data

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Provide deterministic/resettable E2E assignment fixtures
- [ ] Fixtures support at minimum:
  - mine
  - assigned to another user
  - unassigned
  - conflict
  - open Peer Check / no peerChecker where applicable
- [ ] Fixture state can be restored to a known baseline between runs
- [ ] Maestro asserts mine / other / unassigned ownership UI
- [ ] Maestro asserts `record-taken-warning`
- [ ] Maestro proves online first-recording auto-claim using disposable/resettable data
- [ ] Claim updates ownership UI immediately
- [ ] Tests do not mutate shared developer/QA data
- [ ] Fixture/seed/reset requirements are documented in the Maestro guide
- [ ] Existing audit scenarios that were BLOCKED/SKIPPED because of missing fixtures can be executed deterministically

## Related

- Audit: #532 (parent epic #526)
- Assessment (PR): `docs/assessments/chapter-assignment-and-claiming/`
- Task doc: `docs/assessments/chapter-assignment-and-claiming/tickets/maestro-ownership-claim-fixtures.md`
- Historical / related product work: #267, #268, #269, #270, #271, #442, #476
- Sibling offline assignment audit: #533

## Duplicate check

Searched open issues for Maestro/E2E ownership, taken-warning, assignment fixtures, online/auto-claim. Existing product tickets (#269/#270/#271/#442/#476) cover product behavior, not Maestro fixtures + E2E assertions. No equivalent open QA/infra issue found.

comments.body:
## Ticket-level waiver (partial AC)

PR #582 lands the disposable mine / other / unassigned / online auto-claim slice with seed safety guards.

**Waived for this ticket** (tracked on follow-up [#607](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/607)):

1. Conflict fixture role (`hasConflict=true`) — `assign-selected` cannot seed it
2. Open Peer Check fixture role — `assign-selected` cannot set `status=peer_check`
3. Claim baseline restore between runs — API cannot restore `not_started` after auto-claim; suite rotates labels or needs manual Status reset

These remain Product/API decisions; #574 can close when #582 merges with this waiver on the issue.
Cleanup: work already on main (Refs PR merged; Needs QA? No / engineering-only or audit assessment). Board → **Done**, closing.
